duration_s_note: Sum of the two lanes' wall clock plus the two smoke cells. The ON arm cost 345-1673s per cell against 5-43s for the OFF arm -- a 40-190x wall-clock multiplier for the measured effect above.

inference_substrate.principle: The ON arm loads and runs a real 31B GGUF; the OFF arm loads no model at all. Declaring the substrate is what lets the duration floor distinguish a real live run from a fabricated one -- and under THIS experiment's hypothesis an accidental LLM-off ON arm would fabricate exactly the result being sought.

n_ab_perturbed.principle: A byte-identical A/B pair is a NON-OBSERVATION, not a tie: the two arms are the same agent on that cell and no downstream endpoint can differ. Counting perturbation separately from attribution keeps a nondeterministic harness from reading as a treatment effect.

n_attributable.principle: A cell counts only when BOTH arms were separately witnessed to repeat themselves there. One A/A floor measures one arm's determinism; an A/B spans two, and crediting the control arm's self-perturbation to the treatment is the exact over-claim the second floor prevents.

n_cells_llm_tier_fired.principle: Reachability is reported SEPARATELY from value. A cell where the tier never fired is evidence about the tier's REACHABILITY, not about its worth; conflating the two is how an earlier measurement returned UNFALSIFIABLE.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: Declared on every artifact that could be read as a verifier claim so a circular win can never headline as a moat.

headline: Removing the LLM induction tier entirely leaves the live agent's action stream BYTE-IDENTICAL on 5 of 6 games, and changes exactly ONE action out of 60 on the sixth (vc33, at trace index 59 -- the final decision of the episode). Both A/A noise floors are byte-identical on all 6 cells (12/12 replicate pairs, zero divergence), so the harness is deterministic and the one-action difference IS attributable to the LLM -- it is simply almost the entire effect. The tier FIRED in 6 of 6 cells (real CUDA gemma-4-31B induction, 345-1673s each) but its output reached the policy in only 1 of 6: the other 5 inductions were produced and then discarded by the downstream trust gate. This is a reachability failure at the GATE, not at the generator.
internal_control_worth_noting: On tn36 the two ON replicates produced DIFFERENT induction outcomes (degenerate_goal_predicate vs world_model_accuracy_below_threshold) and still emitted byte-identical 60-action traces. The LLM's output changed and the agent's behaviour did not -- independent corroboration that the tier is decoupled from the action stream, obtained without needing the OFF arm at all.
limitations: 6 games, 1 seed each, 60-action budget, max_inductions=2. This is an ACTIVATION pre-flight, not a powered endpoint test; the shipped instrument REFUSES the sign test (ceiling 1 discordant pair vs 6 required at alpha=0.05) and that refusal is the correct reading, not a null result about the LLM's value.

vc33's single divergence lands at index 59 of a 60-action budget, so the effect is CENSORED: the one plan the tier ever got past the gate was 1 action long and began executing on the final step. A larger action budget is required before anyone can say whether that plan would have compounded. This is the single most important caveat and it points AT the treatment, not away from it.

sc25's ON arm induce FAILED outright (proposer_failed_or_missing_root after ~1450s), so that cell's IDENTICAL is partly a generator failure rather than a gate rejection. Counted honestly in the funnel above rather than folded into the gate-rejection count.

The OFF arm removes the generator; it does not remove the induction PHASE. The agent still stalls, still calls induce, and still gets a (False, reason) answer. That is the correct operationalization of 'delete the LLM, keep everything else', but it is not the same as an agent designed without an induction phase.

arms.off: InertProposer: the shipped stub contract (induce -> (False, reason), world_model_candidates -> []) with a HARD RAISE on every generation-substrate name, PLUS a process-wide raiser installed over LocalGGUFProposer.__init__ and every generation method, so no other construction site (e.g. the SGE candidate router) can reach a model either. A completed cell with zero blocked calls is a proof by construction that no token was ever generated.
arms.on: real LocalGGUFProposer bound to the CUDA gemma-4-31B-it server

held_fixed: ONE repo path for all four arms (the previous grid's worktree-vs-canonical split produced a phantom effect that survived 6 replicates)
ONE GPU per game, so the card axis is never confounded with the arm axis
n_ctx=32768 + ffn_cpu_layers=0 + MTP off + non-default port 8931
anonymized policy game id on every arm (hidden-game routing)
identical sampler seed per game across all four arms
method.max_inductions_rationale: At 1 the loop breaks the moment the single induction attempt is recorded, so ~95% of the trace is pre-induction explore and the LLM is structurally incapable of moving it -- 19 of 24 cells in the previous grid were blind for exactly this reason. 2 is the GENEROUS setting for the treatment; a tie at 2 is a stronger result than a tie at 1.

preconditions_checked.resource: per-PID VRAM residency on the requested card
CARNOT_ARC_E3_DIR redirected to scratch (results/arc_e3 never written)

preflight_verdict.interpretation: PASS means only that the treatment perturbs enough cells for the planned sign test to be ABLE to reach significance. It does NOT mean the experiment is powered: perturbation is necessary but not sufficient for discordance on the endpoint. REFUSE means no possible outcome of the grid reaches alpha, so running it cannot produce a finding. INCONCLUSIVE means the probe itself is not finished -- cells are still outstanding that could carry it to a PASS -- so it is NOT evidence that the treatment is inert and must never be cited as one.

what_this_does_and_does_not_license.NOT_licensed: This does NOT show the LLM tier CANNOT help. It shows the tier's output is being discarded by the world-model trust gate before it can act, in 5 of 6 cells. The actionable target is the GATE (accuracy threshold, goal-predicate satisfiability) and the action budget, not the generator or the inducer model. A better inducer banking zero extra levels is exactly what this topology predicts.
what_this_does_and_does_not_license.licensed: Every A/B this session that moved a COMPONENT of the induce -> verify -> plan apparatus was, on 5 of 6 games, measuring a component whose output never reaches the policy. Those nulls are explained without needing any claim about the component. The 0.08 leaderboard plateau is consistent with exploration alone producing the score.
